What usually causes a groove melted into the plate along the edge of the weld (undercut)?
Current too high or a wrong rod angle

A customer says the gate weld you did last week has cracked. What do you do?

Weld a new bead over the crack
Fill it with putty and paint over
Tell him small cracks are normal

పగులు grind చేసి తీసేసి, కారణం తెలుసుకుని, మళ్ళీ weld చేస్తాను

Crack को grind करके निकालूंगा, कारण देखूंगा, फिर से weld करूंगा
Crack के ऊपर नया bead लगा दूंगा
कहूंगा छोटे crack आम बात हैं
A customer wants thinner pipe than you advised for a heavy main gate, to save money. What do you do?
Explain the risk clearly and suggest a safer option
Do it his way and say nothing
Use thin pipe but bill for thick

సన్నని pipe వాడి మందమైన దానికి bill వేస్తాను
भारी main gate के लिए customer पैसे बचाने को आपकी सलाह से पतली pipe चाहता है। आप क्या करेंगे?
खतरा साफ समझाऊंगा और सुरक्षित option बताऊंगा
जैसा कहे वैसा करूंगा, कुछ नहीं बोलूंगा

You finish a grill job at a customer's flat. What is right before you leave?
Clear scrap, check for hot spots, switch off power
Leave the scrap for the watchman

Scrap watchman के लिए छोड़ दें
जल्दी समेटकर अगले काम पर जाएं
कल के लिए machine plug में लगी छोड़ दें
A water tank you welded must be leak-proof. Which simple check can you do on site before handover?
Water fill or soap-bubble test for leaks
Look at the welds from a distance
Give it a thick coat of paint
మీరు weld చేసిన నీళ్ళ tank leak లేకుండా ఉండాలి. Handover ముందు site లో ఏ సులువైన check చేయవచ్చు?
నీళ్ళు నింపి లేదా soap-bubble test తో leak చూడటం
Welds మీద hammer కొట్టి శబ్దం వినడం

Welds पर hammer मारकर आवाज़ सुनना
A butt weld looks fine on top, but the back side shows the root never melted through. What is this, and the fix?

Butt weld పైకి బాగానే ఉంది, కానీ వెనుక వైపు root కరగలేదు. ఇది ఏమిటి, ఎలా సరిచేయాలి?
Incomplete penetration; gap పెంచి మళ్ళీ weld

Incomplete penetration; gap खोलकर दोबारा weld
